prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for the 2D side-scrolling game Grim Run. Create ONE atlas with FOUR separate horizontal ground-mist banks, arranged in four evenly spaced rows, one per row, on a genuinely transparent background. Wide landscape canvas, four long narrow banks with clear empty transparent gutters separating every row; each bank fills about 88% of canvas width, with generous transparent margins at both ends. The game has painterly gothic storybook dark-fantasy art, muted colors, hand-painted atmospheric effects. Subject: ethereal low creeping ground fog, fine irregular translucent wisps, stretched horizontal veils, delicate broken curl tips and thin trailing shreds. Each row has a distinct asymmetrical silhouette and internal flow; row 1 broad low drift, row 2 delicate curling ribbons, row 3 very low stretched veil, row 4 fragmented interweaving shreds. Denser soft pooled mist only in the bottom third of EACH bank, airy partially transparent upper two thirds, uneven low wisps tapering upward. Neutral cool gray-white so game can biome-tint it. Use nuanced opacity within the fog, soft feathered disappearing edges and ends, subtle painted texture. The banks must read as mist passing around ankles and knees, with occasional thin wisps reaching chest height. No outlines or dark contours, no hard bottom edge, no solid cotton cloud lobes, no scenery, no ground, no rocks, no characters, no text, no labels, no grid, no shadow, no colored fringes. Transparent empty space must remain transparent, not checkerboard artwork. This is a standalone texture atlas, not a scene. Output file is a project asset to be saved into the game repository.
